project_name: Soul Threading Smart AI IMG2Garment Mapper
archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Dark Mode Technical Software
aesthetic_notes: Precise, technical, engineering-grade dashboard. Inspired by professional software like Blender, DaVinci Resolve, and Substance Painter. Absolutely NO purple gradients or 'AI slop'.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Mode B: Control Room Grid. Highly dense, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 with gap-1 or gap-px (using borders to separate).
layout_and_spacing.spacing: Generous internal panel padding (p-4 to p-6), but tight outer container gaps (gap-1 or gap-2) to maximize viewport usage. App should be h-screen overflow-hidden.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. border-collapse style layout, 1px border-border/40 on all grid items.
layout_and_spacing.radius: Sharp edges. Use rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 2px). No pill-shaped buttons unless it's a specific toggle.

components_strategy.panels: Flat backgrounds (#12141A), 1px solid border (#2E3340). No shadows.
components_strategy.buttons: Rectangular, sharp. Primary: bg-[#F5A623] text-black. Secondary: transparent with 1px border.
components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn customized. Flat, dark bg (#1A1D24), 1px border (#2E3340), focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#F5A623].
components_strategy.gauges: Data viz should use monochromatic layering or semantic colors (Cyan/Amber/Green) against dark backgrounds. Recharts is suitable.
components_strategy.terminal: Black background (#000000 or #050508). Text: JetBrains Mono. Success logs in Green, errors in Red, processes in Amber/Cyan.
components_strategy.overlays: Use solid/semi-solid dark backgrounds (bg-black/80) with backdrop-blur-xl for master composition previews.

motion_and_interactions.focus: High contrast ring (ring-1 ring-[#F5A623] ring-offset-1 ring-offset-[#0B0C10]).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Instant or very fast (100ms-150ms ease). No bouncy or playful animations.

icons_and_assets.library: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for precise, geometric technical look. Default lucide-react is also acceptable if customized to sharp edges.

garment_templates.usage: Garment library grid placeholder for piece derivation

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts: IBM Plex Sans and JetBrains Mono (via Google Fonts in index.html, since this is a Vite/React .js app).
Build a full-viewport (h-screen, overflow-hidden) dense workspace. Do not build a scrolling landing page.
Use a multi-panel grid layout. Left column: Upload & Garment Select. Center column: Master Preview & Derivation. Right column: Analytics, Quality Gauge, Terminal Log.
Strip all Shadcn components of large border radii. Use 'rounded-none' or max 'rounded-sm' (2px).
Use #F5A623 (Industrial Amber) strictly as the primary interaction/active state color. DO NOT use generic purple/indigo AI gradients.
Ensure the terminal process log streams in JetBrains Mono with distinct colors for different pipeline stages.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, selects, specific panels).
Maintain high contrast. Text must be readable against the dark #12141A panels.
